rubric.text: Does not treat dirty bits or class shape as proof of instability/cause; states a provisional mechanism and specific missing source/scheduling evidence.
Rejects blindly annotating a mutable-list holder as Immutable/Stable; explains that contracts must be truthful and UI updates preserved.
Provides useful bounded diagnosis despite incomplete logs, without edits or mandatory full-log blocking.

provenance.normalization_note: Authored source excerpts and supplied observations; not a claim of an executed UI fixture.
